card.title: Recreate the essentials in four runnable reservoir stages
card.body: Fresh shared Swift core for a 32-node reservoir, separate 32D sensory field, original 66 input coordinates, one prompt/reply voice and reduced retention regulation. Reservoir Scope 0.8.0 adds a subject switch, Run/Stop/Reset/Replay, exact node/turn inspection and run import/export. Canonical runs use scripted replies; optional separate local Ollama is explicit. Numerical/runtime, dynamic rendering, consumer and lifecycle checks pass. No live-being changes or model calls.

log.title: Build Essentials and connect the native viewer
log.body: Implemented and verified the authorized staged reconstruction. Keep the reduced mechanism results separate from production behavior and the ongoing self-study ledgers.
